archetypes.name: dyn-cost-recovery
archetypes.rationale: Verify the ledger fallback reproduces canonical token aggregation and handles multi-ledger/no-marks/symlink edges
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/report_tokens_scan.py (_record, _ledger_fallback_report) and python/tokens.py (build_report_from_ledgers). Verify the ledger-derived report matches the shape and per-vendor totals the canonical token-report-final.json path produces, so recovered design runs are priced identically rather than divergently. Check edge cases: multiple ledgers merged, ledgers with no step marks (must skip via ValueError, not crash the whole scan), symlinked ledgers skipped, and that the intentionally-omitted main-agent claude lane does not cause mis-pricing or a falsely-empty record. Confirm the gc_run_logs keep-set change retains larch-tokens-*.jsonl for design only and not implement. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
